{{short description|Greek economist, teacher and writer}}
'''Christos Laskos''' is a Greek economist, teacher and writer. He was a member of the political secretariat of [[Syriza]] and co-author of ''[[Crucible of Resistance]]'' with [[Euclid Tsakalotos]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/author/L/C/au21610838.html|title=About the Author|website=University of Chicago Press Books|access-date=26 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190709004141/https://www.press.uchicago.edu/ucp/books/author/L/C/au21610838.html|archive-date=9 July 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Political career ==
In 2014, Laskos was selected as one of [[Syriza]]'s candidates for the upcoming [[European Parliament]] [[2014 European Parliament election|election]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://en.protothema.gr/syriza-these-are-the-34-candidates-for-the-european-elections-not-enough-votes-for-the-dean-of-aristotle-university-of-thessaloniki-awaiting-lazopoulos-answer/|title=SYRIZA: These are the 34 candidates for the European elections – Not enough votes for the Dean of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, awaiting Lazopoulos answer|date=14 April 2014|work=Proto Thema|access-date=26 February 2017}}</ref>

Laskos has been described as one of "the best-known intellectuals of Tsipras’s majority". He resigned from Syriza's political secretariat following the announcement of [[September 2015 Greek legislative election|snap elections in September 2015]]. Antonis Davanellos said that following his resignation, Laskos was "trying to organise other forms of opposition to the memorandum policies of Syriza."<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://isreview.org/issue/99/left-after-syriza|title=The Left after Syriza|date=2015|work=International Socialist Review|access-date=26 February 2017}}</ref>
